szenen.vo: [shouting] Stop waiting! [intense] The perfect moment is never coming.
You don't need to fix your whole life tonight.
[intense] One percent. That's it. One percent better... every single day.
[whispers] Sounds like nothing? [intense] Good. That's why nobody does it.
But stack it for one year...
[shouting] And you're thirty-seven times better than the person you are right now!
[intense] Lose one percent a day... and there's nothing left of you.
It was never about talent. Never.
[intense] It's about what you do... today.
[shouting] So get up. And START. NOW!
